title: Step 60-D production Search results
description: Productionize only the Storefront /search route on top of the canonical Step 60-C listing foundation: server-side typed GET /search consumption, deterministic q/cursor/limit preservation, missing/invalid-query handling without speculative backend requests, authoritative ProductCard results, no-result state, bounded safe-read recovery, customer-session cookie propagation, Persian RTL presentation and deterministic SSR verification. Do not implement Category listing, advanced filters, selectable sorting, pagination/infinite controls, suggestions, backend/OpenAPI/database changes, Product Detail, Compare/Wishlist, Cart/Checkout, Admin, SEO hardening reserved for 60-G, or new dependencies. The Stage also performs only the minimum compatibility transition in historical Storefront verifiers that previously required /search to remain a Step-60 placeholder; those checks must accept the new 60-D production Search while continuing to require Category and all later-step routes to remain at their frozen boundaries.

acceptance_criteria.description: The /search loader consumes only the generated OpenAPI GET /search contract through the existing customer-session/API bridge and forwards only validated q/cursor/limit values. No parallel SearchResponse/ProductCard DTO, direct fetch transport, price/inventory authority or client-side ranking is introduced.

Missing q renders a first-use search state without calling the backend. Invalid, duplicate, oversized or undeclared query state fails closed locally without a backend request. Valid q preserves deterministic q/cursor/limit URL state and opaque cursor bytes.

Successful authoritative search data renders shared ListingGrid/ProductCard primitives in backend order; zero items renders an explicit no-result state and no fabricated product, price, stock, sort or suggestion appears.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront search-results:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/storefront static-quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Retryable GET failures use the existing bounded safe-read policy only, with no polling or unbounded automatic retry. Recovery is manual and preserves the validated search URL. Server/session Set-Cookie handling remains delegated to the existing hardened customer-session bridge.

Production SSR evidence covers missing-query, ready results, no-result and bounded recovery. Persian RTL copy, logical CSS, minimum touch target and no-brown rule are preserved. Category remains a placeholder and Stage 60-F filter/sort/pagination controls are not implemented early. Historical Step59/60-C verifiers are transitioned without removing their prior assertions: they may recognize production Search at 60-D while Category and later-step handoffs remain frozen.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront search-results:verify && Step 58 Storefront Quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical completion requires exact-head root pnpm verify, Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 60-E starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 60-D is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 60-E remains blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
